g.text: 1. user should be able to post item for auction with start price and end date
2.user should be able to bid on an item , and bid will only be accepted if greater than the highest bid
3.user should be able to view an auction and highest bid
1.system should be highly consistent showing bidding number to all the users
2strong fault taulerant and durable. we can't drop any bid
3.system should show real time update in highest bid so users know what they are bidding against
4. scale system to handle 10M concurrent request
1.separated post service / bid for independent scaling ,
Post service - requrie high read throguhput
whereas bid service requrie write throughput so both can be optimzed on different workloads
Note 2 : how to make bid highly consistent
1.Lock bid (in bit table) for a sepcific auction id and insert new amount if > current (bad)
(this approach actually does not prevent inserting other txn)
-redis cache provide atomic operation so read-modify-write operation is atomic
- maintain consistency between cache and db
(async update the db if it fail, rollback the cache as well)
3. store max bid in auction and use optimsitic locking
(read the maxbitprice , validate , update the auction with this price)
1.SSE for real time update - push new max bid value whenever
Challenges: scaling the real-time update across multiple servers
SSE Connection for max bid update
